Effective Date: October 2024 1. Use of the Application Ecosort Kiddo is a free educational game designed to teach children proper waste management through a drag-and-drop and clicking the appropriate trash bin mechanic. The app is for personal, non-commercial use only. 2. Ads The game may feature advertisements. By using the app, you agree to view these ads as part of the experience.
